description.value:
You forge a blade of spectral energy and make a melee force attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 necrotic damage.

At 5th level you make two such attacks, at 11th level three, and at 17th level four; each attack requires its own attack roll and can target the same creature or different ones.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
